headline: Executive order adjusting certain federal pay rates, signed by President Biden in December 2022.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order adjusts certain rates of pay. Orders with this title are usually issued each year to set new pay schedules for federal workers, often for the coming calendar year. No summary was provided, so the specific groups and amounts covered are not confirmed here.

who_it_affects.how: Their pay rates may be adjusted under the new schedules this order sets.
Their pay may be adjusted if the order covers military pay, as similar yearly orders often do.
